newsitem.title: EGYPT: Israel's Levy in Egypt for talks with Mubarak.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Levy in Egypt for talks with Mubarak.

text.p: Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy arrived in Egypt on Tuesday for talks with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak on the crisis facing the Middle East peace process.

The latest crisis was touched off by last week's twin suicide bombing in Jerusalem's main Jewish market. The bombings killed 15 people including the two Arab attackers and plunged the already troubled Middle East process into further jeopardy.
Airport sources reported the arrival of the Israeli minister and said that he was greeted at the airport by Foreign Minister Amr Moussa, with whom he held a short meeting.

Moussa had told reporters on Monday that he and Levy would discuss the peace process and "the difficulties it faces, whether from the security angle or other measures that have obstructed the peace process and led to its freeze over the past few months".
